video.label: Display mode
video.unit: Android active mode physical pixel dimensions or unavailable

audio.label: Peak observed skew
audio.unit: absolute source ms sampled at 1 Hz

semantics.queues: Encoded queues: waiting packets; excludes dequeued codec work.
semantics.lastActivity: Monotonic age since last fully received valid media packet; control uses last valid control message, not oldest queue age.
semantics.rtt: Only Control has matching-own-nonce RTT; Video and Audio are not applicable.
semantics.skippedRecent: recent skipped / (recent actual presented + recent skipped); unavailable or empty denominator is N/A.
semantics.peak: Maximum absolute A/V skew observed by 1 Hz overlay sampler since current baseline; not a per-frame or interval maximum.
semantics.audioDeltaFormat: total (+recent) ms; both values use the same sample-frame-derived millisecond unit.
semantics.androidPresented: MediaCodec frame-rendered callback; scheduled releases are separate.
semantics.windowsPresented: Successful platform presentation submission; not actual scanout.
semantics.androidPlaybackEpoch: N/A; audio epoch is a separate Android detail.
semantics.androidOccluded: N/A; no DXGI-equivalent cached visibility signal.
semantics.renderTarget: Full diagnostics only: a verified compositor/render-target measurement, never inferred from encoded size, app view bounds or display mode. Current TextureView path reports N/A.
semantics.displayOutput: Android's reported active Display.Mode dimensions in its mode orientation; not optical projection resolution or proof of native scanout.
semantics.receiverCanvas: App view coordinates, available only in full display diagnostics. Not physical video-buffer resolution.
